That would force an investigator to redo some of the analysis.","problems":["The claim that the 99215 share is 'roughly double the all-provider rate in every complexity band' is not supported by the card. The ratios are about 1.1 to 2.1 (0.039/0.021, 0.072/0.035, 0.11/0.056, 0.183/0.088, 0.216/0.15, 0.37/0.3). The top bands are only about 1.2 to 1.4 times the all-provider rate.","The 99214 'dominates the overall mix' point is true (1538 of 2016) but is irrelevant to the 99215 concern, and the sentence is awkward.","The figures 49% duplicate-flagged notes and 13% repeated-time rate are not on the card. They may come from tool output, but the script could not match 13, so they are unverified here.","The 15% comparison rate is cited but the card shows 14.7%, which is fine. The 'comparison providers' wording is loose.","The headline says the charts 'support the billed levels', which is somewhat in tension with 'inconclusive'. The 17 documented 99215 claims have MDM recorded, but only 1 of the 4 examples shows minutes.","Only two example claims are cited, both N39.0 with 0 conditions. Other low-complexity claims such as C0096299 are mentioned but not cited, and the cited claims do not illustrate the documentation or duplication concerns.","The 21% low-complexity share matches the card's 0.206, but the card does not define whether it covers 0 or 1 conditions as stated, and the summary does not flag this."]}
